seo.title: WG Service OS · After-sales service platform
seo.description: WG Service OS: the system that connects, executes and controls all after-sales service. Core, modules (we do it for you, we control it with you, we support your expansion) and intelligence layers (technical, product, RMA, supply, automation).

hero.subtitle: After-sales service is not a sum of parts. It is a system that must run in a coordinated way. We integrate operations, control and intelligence into one single platform to execute, measure and optimize end to end.
